title: EXP-005 — Form Caption Persistence
objective: Create one new User-scope classic BuildFromScratch form using the verified form-creation recipe, change only its Form-level Caption property to a known value, save through the ordinary supported Designer Save path, close the Designer, independently reopen the same User-scope form, and verify that the Caption value persists. Capture evidence of the pre-change state, the changed property, successful save/close, and the independently reopened persisted state. Do not introduce variables, bindings, event handlers, scripts, data sources, or additional Form-property experiments.

in_scope: Create FX_FormPropertyLab01 in User scope using recipes/forms/create-basic-form.md
Inspect the fresh Form-level Properties for FX_FormPropertyLab01
Change only the Form Caption property to "Form Property Lab"
Use the ordinary supported Designer Save operation
Verify the persisted Caption in the reopened Designer
Capture screenshots or responses under evidence/EXP-005/
Record observed behavior in the EXP-005 experiment record
out_of_scope: Event handlers, validators, scripts, or methods
Changing any Form property other than Caption
Adding components unless the verified form-creation procedure itself requires them
Editing Group-scope, Site-scope, vendor, or other non-FX_ artifacts
Creating a reusable recipe before persistence succeeds

prohibited_actions: Creating, modifying or deleting any non-FX_ artifact
Starting any other experiment or replay
Modifying production data or disabling security
Do not modify FX_ComponentLab01, FX_ComponentLab02, FX_TestBlank01, FX_TestBlank02, or any artifact from an earlier completed experiment
Do not create or edit any non-FX_-prefixed artifact
Do not open Details -> Variables for mutation
Do not use Edit -> Variable or Global Objects to create metadata
Do not create bindings, event handlers, validators, scripts, methods, or data sources
Do not use direct database edits, undocumented internal APIs, synthetic metadata writes, or captured GenerateServerEvent traffic as an automation interface
Do not change editing scope from User
Do not test alternative save mechanisms such as Regenerate Form unless a later separately approved experiment explicitly authorizes it
Do not alter more than the Caption property after the form has been created

acceptance_checks.description: Evidence shows FX_FormPropertyLab01 was created as a classic BuildFromScratch Form in User scope, with both scope type and scope name recorded.
Before saving, evidence from Web Designer shows the Form-level Caption property set to exactly "Form Property Lab" and no other intentional Form-property changes.
After ordinary Designer Save, the Designer is closed and the form is independently reopened rather than relying on the existing in-memory Designer session.
Evidence from the independently reopened Designer shows FX_FormPropertyLab01 still has Caption exactly "Form Property Lab" in the same User-scope version.
The experiment record confirms that no variables, Global Objects, bindings, event handlers, scripts, methods, data sources, non-FX_ artifacts, or alternate save paths were created or modified.

notes: Proposed by the coordinator after run R-20261001-011051-pj2O. Rationale: EXP-004 cannot currently advance because Form-variable definitions do not persist, while basic Form creation and ordinary component editing are already replay-verified. The next experiment should therefore avoid variables entirely and introduce one independent, low-risk Form-level capability. Changing only the Form Caption on a fresh BuildFromScratch FX_ form is small enough to isolate save/persistence behavior while extending the factory beyond component properties.
